title: soliton_solver: A GPU-based finite-difference PDE solver for topological solitons in two-dimensional non-linear field theories
summary: This paper introduces soliton_solver, an open-source GPU-accelerated software package for the simulation and real-time visualization of topological solitons in two-dimensional non-linear field theories. The software is structured around a theory-agnostic numerical core implemented using Numba CUDA kernels, while individual physical models are introduced through modular theory components. This separation enables a single computational framework to be applied across a broad class of systems, from nanoscale magnetic spin textures in condensed matter physics to cosmic strings spanning galaxies…
